ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: Code used to identify the financial instrument.

EmptyBookIndicator.name: Empty Book Indicator
EmptyBookIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there are any orders in the book on the bid and/or offer side.|Usage: If this element is not present, it is considered to be false.

BuySellIndicator.name: Buy Sell Indicator
BuySellIndicator.definition: Side of the order or quote.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Traded price of the transaction excluding, where applicable, commission and accrued interest.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Quantity to be executed, when there is a partial or full execution.

PublicationDateTime.name: Publication Date Time
PublicationDateTime.definition: Date and time when the information was published by the trading venue.

UpdateDateTime.name: Update Date Time
UpdateDateTime.definition: Last update of the date and time when the data was updated.

TradingSystem.name: Trading System
TradingSystem.definition: Status in which the instrument that is traded is in.

BuySellIndicatorGuideline.definition: When EmptyBookIndicator is true, then BuySellIndicator is optional.

PriceGuideline.definition: When EmptyBookIndicator is true, then Price is optional.

QuantityGuideline.definition: When EmptyBookIndicator is true, then Quantity is optional.
